BHPS.revision_notes: 35,630 updated in statistics and notes, native Q4 value becomes 9,250, seven-page PDF and PPTX add Our regulars in correct position with exact quote, attribution and three-sentence notes. Other content and layout retained apart from required footer numbering.

YYIO.craft_notes: Readable conventional meeting deck with balanced stat cards and well-spaced bullets; little distinctive visual character. PPTX text, native chart values and notes verified; PDF broadly matches with shadow and chart positioning differences.
YYIO.revision_notes: Correct total and Q4 value in slides and notes; inserted quote slide uses same card style and three-sentence notes. Chart subtitle and highlight appropriately change from Q3 to Q4, and footer numbering updates. Unchanged content preserved.

pairwise_round1.why: BHPS's warmer PDF typography, coastal waves and more consistent title/footer system give it stronger café character than YYIO's generic presentation template.
